resources.string: How much to send. 25%, 50%, 75% and Max fill in that share of your balance. Gas is paid in ETH, so keep some ETH for it.
Enter the recipient\'s address. You can also enter an ENS name; tap the search icon to resolve it to an address before sending.
The price you pay per unit of gas. Slow, Normal and Fast pay 90%, 100% and 110% of the network\'s current price. Paying more usually confirms sooner.
The active wallet\'s password unlocks its keystore on this device to sign the transaction. Reset clears the form.
Where the transaction is: signed on this device, then sent and waiting to be included in a block. Tap its hash to view it on Etherscan.
The ERC-20 token to send. Pick one from the list, or enter its contract address or ENS name.
The ERC-721 token to send. Pick one you own from the list, or enter its collection\'s address and the token ID.
Search by name, symbol or token ID…
The active wallet does not own this token.

Paste a transaction as JSON to sign with the active wallet. Only Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1) is supported. Online, missing fields such as nonce and gas are filled in from the network before it\'s sent.
What the JSON describes, for checking before you sign. Fields it leaves out are filled in when the transaction is sent.
Offline mode is on: the transaction is signed but not broadcast. Include nonce, gas, maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas.
Signed with your key but not broadcast. Copy it and broadcast it from a device that\'s online.
